purpose: A non-template access stream from a public WCET benchmark. This is an application-derived model scenario, not native multicore or gem5 application performance.
benchmark: TACLeBench V2.0 fir2dim, original 4x4 image and 3x3 filter
shared_data: padded fir2dim_array only, 36 floats, 64-byte aligned, 64-byte lines; coefficients and outputs private
phases: first output row; remaining output rows; result checksum. Stop before the second pin_down writes inputs.
instrumentation: log input-array read offsets and phase markers, preserve dereference value and original return code; compare native baseline and instrumented executable
writer: 192 stores cycling the three input-array lines, separately declared refresh interferer; not in the original single-thread benchmark
tick_phases: select at0; evaluate selected loads on1..9
reported: all9 scenarios, including ties/regressions; actual misses and traffic; bounds; no wallclock cycles from host compilation
